# Evolutionary Terminal — The Day of Maurício Issei (1982–2026)

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/terminal-evolutivo>. Author: **Maurício Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-06-22 · Updated: 2026-06-30.

## The narrative, in scenes

The page is a sequence of scenes, from 1982 to the present: childhood (1982–1990, without siblings, the imagination filling the room; the TV heroes — Jaspion, Changeman, Kamen Rider — as a moral code, and the street/skate/bicycle/videogame as a sandbox); the craft (in 2000, the whole day on the support of a dialed internet provider — which was not the first job: at 16 had already been shopkeepers in a shopping mall —, learning to listen before answering, working day and studying at night); the first fracture (April 2004, the loss of the father, and the learning to follow even without being ready); graduation (2005, the diploma in Information Systems with specialisation in logistics such as the delivery that the father did not see, next to the mother); the foundation (the love of life found in 2009 and the marriage in 2011); the birth of the daughter (2012, when the vector of life changes speed to durability — to overcome the root to protect); the house (the bodie twins and the rest of life). A coda reveals the three names: Shokunin, Kintsugi and Bamboo.

## Three Japanese philosophies

Shokunin (the craft as a way to improve), Kintsugi (the fracture filled with gold becomes the most beautiful part) and Bamboo (deep roots, unbreakable bending, endless growth). They do not label the page; they are discovered by the narrative and named only in the coda — mirroring the life of the author, a descendant of Japanese, who lived these ideas before finding the words.

## Technical architecture

CSS-first: Semantic HTML (preserving SEO and accessibility) on an environment layer made only with CSS and SVG — the lacquer background, the analog grain and the golden kintsugi seam. Revelations while rolling use IntersectionObserver as a progressive enhancement. There is no WebGL; everything remains readable without JavaScript and respects preferred-motion.

## Glossary

- **Scrollytelling** — Narrative whose visual progression is controlled by the user scroll.
- **Shokunin (** — The Japanese craftsman whose identity is infinite devotion to the craft; the work is never "ready". On the page, work as a path — not as a resume.
- **Kintsugi (** — The art of repairing broken pottery with gold, making the fracture the most beautiful part. On the page, the pains that became force.
- **Bamboo** — Plant of interconnected roots that folds without breaking and grows endless. On the page, the network that sustains and the open ending that continues.
- **Progressive enhancement** — Extra layer (CSS/JS) which enriches the experience without being a prerequisite of the content.
